new_capability: Import hash-pinned review copies while preserving original task/response text and fixed denominators, then produce explicitly provisional agreement accounting
rules: Original blank packet and submitted review files have separately pinned file digests
Only disclosure and review cells may change; task text, output text, item order and instructions cannot change
Raw supplied judgments and source digests are retained in private sealed output
Missing review, blank label, disagreement, duplicate reviewer code and inadequate disclosures remain unknown
A definitive label requires a nonempty reason and verbatim quote found in the saved contract
Internally inconsistent whole-contract and field-only/omission judgments remain unresolved pending clarification
Invalid-format or non-stop response is not promoted by reviewer agreement
All six history pairs remain in missing-label bounds, with read-price-eight minus read-price-one orientation
Agreement is provisional, not adjudication, verified human independence or task/reference admission

verification.scope: Synthetic review labels, mocked replies, temporary archives and local file integrity checks only

limitations: Hashes establish file identity, not the authenticity or quality of human review
Self-reported independence and request-review references require separate scrutiny
Two agreeing labels do not establish correct task/reference adjudication
No automatic adjudication of disagreements is implemented or implied
Provisional missing-label bounds are not confidence intervals or causal estimates
No cache-price effect or method increment is established by these tests
next_scientific_gate: A separately authorized fixed model batch followed by independent semantic review; no larger study or named method before measurement and strong-baseline gaps are established
